warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: An existing RFQ in evaluation with two lines and Vendor A quotes of 100 and 50; Countering both lines independently to 90 and 45; Verifying that one untouched line retains its original quote while the other line changes; Verifying two-line Master QCS totals based on the mixed current prices

steps.note: Open the prepared buyer Responses screen with the vendor's normal bid.
Send a buyer counter offer on the vendor's own bid using the supported single-price counter-offer flow.
Assert that the vendor's response is marked with a counter offer.
Move to the separate vendor portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Have the invited vendor accept the pending counter offer.
Return to the buyer's event page to inspect the accepted response.
Assert that the buyer's Responses grid marks the vendor's counter offer as accepted.
Open the buyer's Master QCS to inspect the current bid after acceptance.
Assert that the prepared single-vendor QCS contains the responding vendor column.
Assert that the supported countered price is reflected in the QCS rate cell.
Assert the supported single-line QCS amount and total arithmetic.
